items.text: Dear Adventurer,

To provide adventurers with a better experience, the Guild will be issuing a temporary restraining order on all adventurer activities in Atlan starting on November 12, 2026 at 06:00 (UTC+0). This order is expected to remain in effect for approximately 4 hours (maintenance may end earlier or be extended depending on actual conditions). During this time, servers will be closed, and all Adventurers will not be able to log in to the game. After the maintenance ends, please restart the game client and update the game before you return for a new chapter in your adventure.

Adventurers who have one or more characters created before the maintenance begins will receive a compensation of Prismadium x100 for this downtime via mail. This compensation can only be claimed once per account. Remember to claim it before it expires! Thank you for your support and cooperation!
I. Version Update Content
▨ Level 80 Co-op Dungeon - Frostbound Penance

For a thousand years, a blasphemous sacrificial rite has continued in the underground ice cavern. The ambition to ascend to godhood has now crumbled to dust, yet the taboo sealed within still slowly stirs to life...
1. Start Time: November 14, 10:00 (Server time of your character's server). Reach Level 80 and complete the corresponding quest to unlock.
2. Reward attempts for the "Frostbound Penance" Co-op Dungeon reset every Thursday at 06:00.
3. Clearing "Frostbound Penance" may drop rewards such as: Remnant Soulember, Infernal Flame Crown, Langovi Insignia and Modules, Beelzebub Insignia and Modules, Deus Insignia and Modules, and more.
▨ "Frostbound Path" Event Launch

1. The first 24 Adventurers on each server to clear "Frostbound Penance - Elite" will receive the limited title "Divine Inquisitor." To earn this reward, all party members must be from the same connected server group when entering the dungeon. However, if the party includes Adventurers from different servers, none of them may have claimed a first-clear reward before. (Each Adventurer occupies one first-clear slot on their own server.)
2. The first 4 Adventurers across all servers to clear it will also be inducted into the "Hall of Honor - Frostbound Penance" hall (located on the third floor).
3. Adventurers who clear "Frostbound Penance - Elite" will unlock a Combat Buff and receive Remnant Soulember and Infernal Flame Crown rewards.

4. Assist other Adventurers in clearing "Frostbound Penance - Elite" to accumulate Support Points, climb the assist rankings, and earn the exclusive moniker "Sinner's Covenant," Frostbound Penance Module Selection Boxes, and other generous Co-op Dungeon material rewards.

Support Point Rules: You will receive different Support Points based on the current Conquest Progress when providing assistance to other adventurers. (The lower the Conquest Progress, the more Support Points earned.)
▨ "Singularity Casket" Pack Optimization
1. Upon clearing the Co-op Dungeon "Frostbound Penance" in Story or Elite Mode while meeting the Power requirement, 4 Singularity Casket Packs will drop.

2. The Singularity Casket Packs that previously refreshed every Thursday in the Guild Treasury will now become available for purchase after clearing "Frostbound Penance" in Story or Elite Mode while meeting the required Power. The purchase limit has also been increased by 3.
3. Buds of Retrospection can now be obtained via Singularity Caskets.
4. After maintenance, clearing "The Deep Dive" will no longer grant Singularity Casket Packs.
▨ Co-op Dungeon Reward Adjustments
1. "The Deep Dive" will no longer drop Dark Crystals or Eternal Artifact Boxes.
2. "Frostbound Penance" on Story Mode and above now has a chance to drop Dark Crystals and Eternal Artifact Boxes.
▨ New Season of "Ancient Battlefield League"

a. The Ancient Battlefield League preparation phase has begun. After maintenance, Fleet captains can assign Ancient Battlefield squad captains and create squads in the - [Ancient Battlefield] interface. After creating a squad, squad captains can invite Fleet and Fleet Alliance members to join the squad, and Fleet members are also free to apply to join on their own initiative.

b. The new season of the Ancient Battlefield League will officially begin on November 16, 2026 at 06:00 (server time of your character's server). Initial placements will be based on Squad Power, dividing squads into Group S, Group A, Group B, Group C, the Selection Group, and the Participation Group. The initial placement has a significant impact on the squad's match schedule for the season, so please ensure your squad is in optimal configuration during placement.
c. Squad Power is related to squad members' Gear Rating and member count. Increase squad members' Gear Rating and ensure you have at least 16 squad members to achieve higher Squad Power values.
d. Other detailed rules can be viewed by opening the Rules section in the - [Ancient Battlefield] interface.
After maintenance, Ancient Battlefield Match and League battles will no longer have a minimum player requirement.
II. Optimizations
[Co-op Dungeon Optimizations]
1. Significantly reduced the HP of enemies in Solo Mode for the Co-op Dungeon "Shackled Psyche."
2. For the Co-op Dungeon "Shackled Psyche," Bots have been added to assist in Story Mode (Bots can be matched when using Quick Match on the Team-up platform).

3. After this maintenance, when you clear "The Deep Dive" dungeons with remaining reward attempts, you can obtain 2 Buds of Retrospection (unavailable in Solo Mode). Consuming Buds of Retrospection directly grants 1 set of rewards for the corresponding dungeon. The rewards are based on the highest difficulty you've cleared; if you haven't cleared the dungeon before, you'll receive rewards for Solo difficulty.
[Heterogeneous Inscription Voucher Optimizations]

Added descriptions for vouchers obtainable through "Abyssal Purgatory III" and the "2 newest recommended Lv.80 Co-op Dungeons." (You can obtain 1/3/4 respectively from Story/Elite/Legend difficulty of the Co-op Dungeons.)
Heterogeneous Inscription Vouchers can now also be purchased in the Shop, with each voucher costing 20 Prismadium.
[Other Optimizations]
1. Mentors can now set "Lv.80 Eternal Gear" as an Apprentice reward.
2. In the Ore Shop, the weekly purchase limit for Blackrock (crafting material for Double Potions) has been changed to 300.
3. The "Doradoween" event has been extended until November 25 (server time of your character's server).
5. To help adventurers get rewards quicker, the drop rates of Neurochips, Cyber Cores, and Prime Prosthetics in the Soul Resonance event will be increased after the maintenance!
Dear Adventurer,

To provide adventurers with a better experience, the Guild will be issuing a temporary restraining order on all adventurer activities in Atlan starting on November 5, 2026 at 06:00 (UTC+0). This order is expected to remain in effect for approximately 4 hours (maintenance may end earlier or be extended depending on actual conditions). During this time, servers will be closed, and all Adventurers will not be able to log in to the game. After the maintenance ends, please restart the game client and update the game before you return for a new chapter in your adventure.

Adventurers who have one or more characters created before the maintenance begins will receive a compensation of Prismadium x100 for this downtime via mail. This compensation can only be claimed once per account. Remember to claim it before it expires! Thank you for your support and cooperation!
I. Version Update Content
▨ Summons Shop - Treasure Redemption Update
Now available: Starry Sky Aura, Emerald Dawn Weapon, Astral Aura Insignia, and Frostleaf Title Insignia.
No longer available: Golden Dreamland Aura, Golden Aura Insignia, and Golden Title Insignia.
▨ New Exploration Rewards
1. Added rewards for 235-260 Exploration.
2. The recipe and other rewards previously awarded at 220 Exploration are now awarded at 250 Exploration. Duplicate recipes can be sold.
▨ Growth Supplies Event Adjustments
To claim the "Enhancement Amplification Selection Box II" in the Growth Supplies event, you now need at least one character at Lv.80 or above on the same server.
▨ Outfit Attribute Adjustments
The following outfits now grant higher bonus attributes. Their main and bonus attributes will also increase periodically.
1. Titles: Resonance Lv.275 Exclusive Title, Void Crown, Uptown Elites, Master of Authorities.
2. Auras: Pure Heartfire Oath, Endless Battle - Supreme, Dark Realm.
II. Optimizations
PVP Mechanics Optimizations
In Ancient Battlefield, Mine Wars, and Power Climb Championship, certain attributes will receive a boost if they fall below a set value. The boost will cover a percentage of the difference.
"Optimizations"
1. Shout to share your homestead layout plan to earn bonus Prismadium. You can earn this reward once per month for each Homestead area.
2. Homestead layout plans shared via Shout now display the plan name and the Homestead area they belong to.
3. While Simulated Warzone is active, you can access the event through a rotating banner on the main interface.
4. Adjusted the Character Energy cap so you can use all your Energy items, including Batteries and Energy Storage, at once.
5. The Inscription interface now shows how much Heterogeneous Inscriptite you have.
6. When exchanging items, the minimum quantity is now selected by default.
7. The number of Epic Shards required to craft Lv.75 Epic Gear has been adjusted from 1000 to 300.
8. 1 Beetle Spine Desirium can be exchanged for 1 Demon Axe Desirium.
9. DEF Shred (formerly PvE DEF Shred) under the Enhancement Attributes of Lv. 75 and higher Armor and Trinkets now takes effect in all PvP modes, functioning as both PDEF Shred and MDEF Shred.
III. Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue that occasionally caused the Tachikoma to deal incorrect DMG in the Simulated Warzone event.
2. Fixed an issue where level progress was displayed incorrectly when the Tachikoma reached max level in the Simulated Warzone event.
3. Fixed an issue where unbound tickets were consumed first in Abyssal Purgatory III.
4. Fixed an issue where the Gluttonous Feast Ring's effect did not increase Realm Potion levels as intended.
5. Fixed an issue where the combo count for Specter's "Moonscar" skill was incorrect.

6. Fixed an issue that prevented players from earning the "Devourer of Light" achievement by clearing the Abyss Challenge in Court of Oaths. You must clear the challenge again to earn the achievement.
7. Fixed an issue where some values for Berserker and Blademaiden's Unrivaled Techniques were incorrect.
8. Fixed an issue where Sugariff's PvP DMG was abnormal.
9. Fixed an issue where the Merchants' Guild pink gear donation rules were abnormal.
10. Fixed an issue where the second circuit slot could not be selected on controllers.
Dear Adventurer,

To provide adventurers with a better experience, the Guild will be issuing a temporary restraining order on all adventurer activities in Atlan starting on October 28, 2026 at 06:00 (UTC+0). This order is expected to remain in effect for approximately 4 hours (maintenance may end earlier or be extended depending on actual conditions). During this time, servers will be closed, and all adventurers will not be able to log in to the game. After the maintenance ends, please restart the game client and update the game before you return for a new chapter in your adventure.

Adventurers who have one or more characters created before the maintenance begins will receive a compensation of Prismadium x100 for this downtime via mail. This compensation can only be claimed once per account. Remember to claim it before it expires! Thank you for your support and cooperation!
I. Version Update Content
[New Lv.80 Content]
▨ New Level Cap - 80!!

After a long absence, Conrad has finally emerged! Frost and blood intertwine as a hymn of evolution echoes through the Ice Valley—the time has come for the world to face final judgment. This is where fates will be decided and old scores will be settled. Brace yourself, for you are about to face off against a Sage...

1. After the update, adventurers who reach Lv.70 can complete Level Breakthrough quests to raise their level cap to 80! Unlock the new adventure chapter "Frozen Sanctuary" and a fresh lineup of powerful high-level gear! Completing the breakthrough will also unlock the "New Fate Chapter" event, where you can earn a variety of rare rewards!

2. New adventure stories, Elite Dungeons, Abyssal Purgatory, and new exploration areas await! Come experience the brand-new story of the Frozen Sanctuary! To ensure a balanced gameplay experience, damage will be adjusted for the first character on each account to enter the dungeon.
3. At Lv.80, the friend limit increases to 500. New achievements related to friends have also been added.
4. Added level-up rewards for Lv.75 and Lv.80. Rewards for permanent in-game events have also been updated for Lv.80.
▨ Major Gear Update
[New Lv.75/80 Gear]
1. Added Lv.75/80 Epic weapons, armor, and trinkets, along with a new tier of Eternal Gear.
2. Added 3 new series of Lv.75 Epic weapons, all obtainable as drops.
3. Only Lv.70 Consciousness series weapons can be upgraded to Lv.75.
[New Epic Gear - Pilgrim]
1. Added the Epic "Pilgrim" set. Its full set bonus adjusts to your attributes: any affected attribute below the specified threshold increases by a percentage of the difference.
[New Eternal Gear]
1. The new armor and trinket sets include a higher-quality Eternal Gear piece in one slot.

2. Eternal Gear has stronger attributes and effects. You can equip up to one Eternal armor piece (Helmet, Breastplate, Gloves, Pants, or Shoes) and one Eternal Trinket (Necklace, Bracers, Ring, Stamp, or Talisman).
[Gear Conversion]

1. Use Gear Crafting to convert Lv.80 Epic Gear and Eternal Gear into other gear for the same slot. Once you unlock a crafting blueprint, you can use it to convert Lv.80 Epic Gear into another Lv.80 Epic piece you need for that slot.
2. Conversion is only available between gear of the same slot (e.g., Helmet → Helmet) and cannot be done across different slots.
3. Gear retains all upgrades after conversion.
4. Crafting blueprints are unlocked per character, not per account.
5. Visit Glenn and select "Gear Crafting" > "Set Conversion" to convert Lv.75/80 Epic and Eternal sets with one click.
[Inscription Adjustments and Heterogeneous Inscriptions]
1. Added Inscription achievements. (If you already meet the requirements, unequip and re-equip your gear or Inscriptions to trigger them.)
a. Own 3 Superior Techniques Lv.3 to obtain 1 Unrivaled Technique Lv.3.
b. Own 2 Extraordinary Techniques Lv.3 to obtain 1 Lv.3 Clothing Heterogeneous Inscription Selection.
c. Own 3 Transcendent Techniques Lv.3 to obtain 1 Unrivaled Technique Lv.3.
d. Own 2 Advanced Skills Lv.3 to obtain 1 Lv.3 Clothing Heterogeneous Inscription Selection.
2. A new "Heterogeneous Inscription" tab has been added to the Inscription Shop, and the original Inscription Store tab has been renamed to "Lv.70 Inscription."
a. Heterogeneous Inscriptions cannot be obtained by refreshing the Lv.70 Inscription tab.

b. In the Heterogeneous Inscription tab, you can exchange Inscriptite for Heterogeneous Inscriptite. You can also exchange Heterogeneous Inscriptite and Heterogeneous Inscription Vouchers for Heterogeneous Inscriptions.

a. Lv.75+ Epic Gear will randomly gain Heterogeneous Inscriptions, but Heterogeneous Inscriptions can only be embedded into pink Heterogeneous Inscription sockets. Different gear slots can accept different types of Heterogeneous Inscriptions.

b. Lv.75 Epic Gear has two Inscription sockets: a blue Inscription socket that can only hold non-Heterogeneous Inscriptions (i.e., Inscriptions from the Lv.70 version), and a pink Heterogeneous Inscription socket that can only hold Heterogeneous Inscriptions (i.e., Heterogeneous Inscriptions introduced in this update).
c. Lv.80 Epic Gear has three Heterogeneous Inscription sockets, which can only hold Heterogeneous Inscriptions.
d. Heterogeneous Inscriptions have special Heterogeneous Attributes. Once an Inscription reaches Lv.3, you can spend materials to upgrade its Heterogeneous Attribute, up to Tier 3.

e. The "Unrivaled Technique" Heterogeneous Inscription introduced in this update is mutually exclusive with the non-Heterogeneous Inscriptions "Transcendent Technique," "Superior Technique," and "Extraordinary Technique." In other words, if any equipped gear has "Unrivaled Technique" socketed or innately possesses its effect, you cannot socket "Transcendent Technique," "Superior Technique," or "Extraordinary Technique" on any equipped gear, and vice versa.
▨ New Abyssal Purgatory Difficulty
1. Added Abyssal Purgatory Difficulty III. Entry requires the new dungeon ticket, Hunter's Contract.

2. Clearing it has a chance to drop Lv.75 Epic Gear, Eternal Gear, Lv.75 Epic Gear Shards, and other rewards. Adventurers can also use the Prayer feature to increase the drop rate of their selected gear.

3. Added Eternal Prayer to increase the chance of Eternal Gear dropping. Eternal Gear drops are tracked per character, not per account. Once an Eternal Gear piece drops, it will not drop again until that character has obtained every Eternal Gear piece. The drop record then resets, allowing the character to collect them all again.

4. Fill the Eternal Prayer gauge with Prayer items to unlock "Special Prayer." Choose an Eternal Gear piece, and your next Eternal Gear drop is guaranteed to be that piece. Once every piece of Eternal Gear has dropped at least once, Special Prayer is no longer available.
[Ghost in the Shell Collaboration Content]
▨ Soul Resonance
Event Duration: October 28, 06:00 - November 25, 06:00 (Server time of your character's server, available after the maintenance)
Warning! Unknown network connection detected in Atlan...
The Crystal of Atlan x Ghost in the Shell: S.A.C. collaboration has been confirmed! Public Security Section 9 has connected to Atlan's network. Team up with Motoko Kusanagi and begin a new adventure!
[Mind Sync]
Log in daily to claim the Avatar Frame - Section 9 Certified, the SS Title - Ghost in the Shell, Arcanite of Adore, and other rewards.
[Simulated Warzone]

During the event, enter matchmaking and pilot a Tachikoma against other adventurers. Your performance determines your ranking and the Neurochips and Prime Prosthetics you earn at the end of the battle.
Obtain a specified number of Prime Prosthetics to claim the SS Footprint - Ghost Afterimage, Eternal Artifact Box, Potent Catalyst, and other rewards.
[Memory Dive]
During the event, spend Energy to obtain Cyber Cores. Consume Cyber Cores to conduct intelligence searches and earn Neurochip rewards.
Collect a specified amount of intelligence to claim event-exclusive Emoticons, Avatars, Insignia Module Selection Boxes, and other rewards.
[Tactical Protocol]

Earn Neurochips in "Simulated Warzone" and "Memory Dive" to level up "Tactical Protocol" and claim rewards. There are two reward tracks: Normal Supplies, with rewards for each character, and Advanced Supplies, with rewards for the account. Advanced Supplies requires a purchase to unlock.

Unlocking Advanced Supplies grants additional rewards: a Tachikoma Gift Card (unlocks the collaboration Mount Tachikoma), an Insignia Module Selection Box, Arcanite of Adore, an Eternal Circuit Selection Box Lv.30, and more.
▨ Collaboration Mount "Tachikoma"
Though independent, we all share the same wish.
1. During the Ghost in the Shell collaboration, the "Tachikoma" mount series will be available for purchase.
2. Purchase "Tachikoma - Black" to obtain the mount. It adds 2 points to Mount Collection Progress, separately from the other colors.

3. "Tachikoma - Pink," "Tachikoma - Red," "Tachikoma - Yellow," and "Tachikoma - Blue" collectively add 1 point to Mount Collection Progress. Obtain them by unlocking Advanced Supplies in Tactical Protocol.
▨ Dive Initiation Pet Summons
1. Event Duration: After the maintenance - before the December 24, 2026 maintenance
2. This event's S-grade grand prize is any one of the following of your choice: "Motoko Kusanagi," "Blue Flame Eagle," or a "Legacy Orange Pet."
a. Motoko Kusanagi is a collaboration pet (collaboration pets cannot be used to activate Pet Cards) and will be removed early after maintenance on November 26.
b. Using a Blue Flame Eagle Contract immediately unlocks a 3-star pet. It can also activate Pet Cards.
3. During the event, adventurers can use "Arcanite of Adore" to perform summons. If you don't have enough "Arcanite of Adore," you can use "Prismadium" or "Opals" instead.

4. Please note that while the pity progress from the previous Pet Summons event will be carried over to "Dive Initiation," the cumulative summon rewards progress will be reset for the new rewards in this event.
[Doradoween Series Events]
▨ Doradoween
Event Duration: October 28, 06:00 - November 18, 06:00 (Server time of your character's server, available after the maintenance)
Autumn winds return to Alnado City's ancient streets, carrying the soft echoes of Midnight Festival bells.
Complete the Wonderland main quest to unlock "A Pumpkin Performance." Finish it to unlock the event series and receive "Pumpkin Fiend - Limited." Join the fun and make this a night to remember!
"Journey Memories"
Spend Energy to obtain puzzle pieces. Complete puzzles to obtain Midnight Fudge, Hunter's Contract, Prismadium, and other rewards.
[Pumpkin Fun]
Pumpkins lurking in the shadows, pumpkins patrolling everywhere, pumpkins that hate humans... and the mastermind behind it all—Lord Fat Ken!

Gather your friends and challenge Lord Fat Ken, who's causing mischief in Wonderland! Midnight Fudge will be scattered around the stage during the challenge! Clear the challenge for a chance to obtain the tradeable exclusive headwear "Pumpkin Fiend"!
[Joyful Banter]

Wear "Pumpkin Fiend - Limited" and find the actors hidden among the NPCs in Lumiville, Rhine City, and Wonderland. Exchange a look with them to earn Midnight Fudge, Jester's Badges, plenty of Bound Gold, and more.
[Pumpkin Hunt]
Find all the strange pumpkins hidden in Lumiville to win the limited Achievement—Pumpkin Trick!
[Midnight Store]

Use Midnight Fudge collected during the event to redeem the exclusive Headwear "Demon Horns," the exclusive Avatar "Pumpkin Fiend," Heterogeneous Inscriptite, an Insignia Module Selection Box, and more!
[Other Content]
▨ "Overdrive Rebel" Limited Summons
1. Event Time: After the maintenance - before the January 28, 2027 maintenance

2. The "Endless Summer" limited summons has been replaced with the new theme "Overdrive Rebel," inheriting the pity count from "Endless Summer." The cumulative draw rewards will be reset for the new rewards.

3. The S-grade grand prizes for this event are: Radiant Starstream Footprint and Overclock Footprint Insignia. Adventurers can choose any one reward for summoning. Chosen rewards can be changed at any time, and the pity count carries over.
4. The A-grade reward for this event is the "Overdrive Rebel" outfit.
5. Adventurers can redeem the "Overdrive Rebel" outfit, avatar frame, and avatar via "Shop - Summon - Outfit."
6. During the event, adventurers can use "Arcanite of Brocade" to perform summons. If you don't have enough "Arcanite of Brocade," you can use "Prismadium" or "Opals" instead.
▨ New Season in "The Nexum"
In the Void, the Nexum has once again taken another shape. Are you ready to face the Nexum's new challenge?
1. "Interlaced Stillframe" has temporarily disappeared into the Void. Look forward to its return!
2. "Erosion Key Forging" is back. Find Maltz before the boss stage to obtain and forge Erosion Keys that will help you in battle.
3. Balance adjustments have been made to certain stage difficulty levels.
4. Unlock conditions and effects for certain Deep Activations have been adjusted.

5. Adjusted the effects of Rainbow and Platinum Runes: selecting a Rainbow Rune now grants direct entry to the treasure mezzanine, while selecting a Platinum Rune increases the forging chance for Phantom Keys.
6. Slightly increased the stats of orange, blue, and green runes.
▨ Card Update
1. Added the "Prisoner of Evolution" Deck.
2. Added "Frostblood Hymn" Card Packs to the Card Pack Machine and Nexum Shop. Each pack has a 50% chance to yield a card from the "Prisoner of Evolution" Deck.
3. Reduced the prices of older Card Packs in the Card Pack Machine.
4. Nexum Exploration rewards now include "Gold Command" Card Packs, each containing 6 cards with 1 guaranteed random Epic Card from the new Deck.
"New Deck Card Slot"
A new card slot has been added to the Deck, unlocked after clearing Frostbound Penance on Story difficulty.
▨ Mentorship Season 2
After the maintenance on October 28, 2026, adventurers identified as "Mentors" or "Apprentices" can access Mentorship Season 2.
In the Mentorship Shop, all items for Mentor Exchange and Apprentice Exchange have been reset to new items (Master Exchange rewards remain unchanged).
Mentorship level rewards have been replaced with new items.
"Special Notes"

1. For mentors and apprentices who have not yet graduated, their mentorship relationship will be reset to Level 1 upon the start of Mentorship Season 2, and they can claim the corresponding season's rewards upon reaching the appropriate mentorship level. If a reward set by the mentor is unclaimed, it will be distributed to the apprentice or returned to the mentor based on whether the mentorship level met the claim requirement.

2. Apprentices who have already graduated may voluntarily dissolve their completed mentor-apprentice relationship and seek a new mentor if their current Power does not meet the requirement to become a mentor in Season 2.

3. Mentorship Benefits: When a mentor and apprentice enter a Co-op Dungeon together, the apprentice can use the mentor's weapon with its enhancement level reduced by 2. The maximum enhancement level for this benefit has increased from 19 to 20.
A great adventure requires not only courage, but also guides and companions.
Get ready to find your guiding light in Atlan, or become the beacon for someone else!
▨ New Adventurer's Manual
1. The new Adventurer's Manual will open after the October 28 maintenance. Complete daily, weekly, and seasonal quests to level up your manual and obtain abundant material rewards.

2. Unlock the Advanced Manual: As your manual level increases, you can additionally obtain Opals, Pet Pack (Previous Pet Selection), Arcanite of Adore, Lv.80 +13 Enhancement Voucher, Beetle Spine Desirium, and other rewards.

3. Unlock the Collector's Manual: Total rewards include Opal x600, Severance Component x1, Energy Box x10, United Battle x5, Card Pack Selection x10 (includes Frostblood Hymn), Emote Selection Box (includes previous Adventurer's Manual emotes, Emote - Quacky Dance, Emote - Joyful Beats), Avatar Frame - Sights: Snowy Peak, as well as privileges such as Weapon Sync, getting 3 additional items in the Wondrous Shop, Multi-Title display, and other rewards.

4. This Adventurer's Manual will open after the October 28 maintenance. The Adventurer's Manual feature will be temporarily unavailable from 06:00 on October 28 until the maintenance concludes. Please plan accordingly to avoid missing out on rewards.
▨ "Golden Gifts" Event Launch

1. From after this maintenance until before the November 26 maintenance, upon reaching a certain amount of cumulative Gold purchases in the Consignment House, you will receive additional Bound Gold, Prismadium, Opals, and other rewards.
2. There are 2 rounds in this event. Purchase 500 million Gold to receive all rewards in one round.
▨ Limited-Time Cumulative Top-Up Event
1. Event Duration: After the maintenance - before the November 26 maintenance. Requires Adventure Level ≥10.

2. Event Details: During the event period, points obtained from top-ups will be calculated cumulatively, and you can unlock rewards upon reaching specific point milestones. Rewards include Arcanite, Enhancement Vouchers, Enhancement Fund, and more!
▨ "First Top-up Pack" Reset
1. After the maintenance, the first top-up pack will be reset. Characters can receive first top-up rewards by topping up any amount.

2. Rewards must be claimed by logging in for three days. Rare rewards include: Rare quality weapon (scales with your adventurer level, up to Lv.80), Lv.80 +13 Enhancement Voucher, Unrivaled Technique Lv.3, and more.
▨ Growth Supplies
1. Event Duration: Available long-term after the October 28 maintenance.

2. When any character under your account reaches the specified level, you can claim the Orange Pet Selection Pack (choose 1 from Brilliant Crystafox Contract, Thunder Knight Contract, Gentleman Fancy Contract, Ancestral Whelp Contract, Martial Panda Contract), the Overdrive Rebel Outfit Bag (obtain the full Overdrive Rebel Outfit Set + Arcanite of Brocade x10), and the Enhancement Amplification Selection Box (choose 1 from Exclusive +15 Voucher or 4-Star Repair Catalyst).
3. After the October 28 update and maintenance, the claim count will reset, limited to 1 claim per account.
▨ Forging Supplies
1. Event Duration: October 28, 06:00 - November 27, 06:00 (Server time of your character's server, available after the maintenance).

2. Event Rules: During the event period, equipping a weapon that reaches the specified enhancement level or spending the specified amount of Gold allows you to claim a large amount of Enhancement Fund.
3. Adventurers who have triggered Starter Enhancement cannot participate in this event.

4. Adventurers who have already claimed weapon enhancement rewards in the previous Enhancement Benefits Season event cannot claim rewards for the same weapon enhancement tier again in this Forging Supplies event.
▨ Avatar Frame/Avatar Return
After the maintenance, you can purchase the following Avatars/Avatar Frames in the Info - Customize Avatar screen:
1. Endless Summer and Hero's Journey series Avatars and Avatar Frames.
2. Avatar Frames from Adventurer's Manual Issues 12-13.
II. Return and New Adventurer Events
▨ Beginner's Express
Event Duration: After maintenance, a new Beginner's Express event will begin. Once triggered by an adventurer, the event will last for 21 days.

Event Rules: Create a new account on any server and reach Lv.19 with a character to unlock this event series. Adventurers who create a new account after October 26, 14:00, will keep their eligibility and trigger this Beginner's Express event after the October 28 maintenance.

Event Rewards: This event includes "Beginner's Privilege," "Path of New Beginnings," "Beginner's Guidebook," "Starter Enhancement," "New Beginnings Cumulative Top-up," "Harvest Time," and more. Join the event to directly claim a full set of Lv.70 Epic Gear and other rewards. You'll also receive Co-op Dungeon buffs, Enhancement Fund drops, and other bonuses during the event to easily boost your character and catch up with the latest content.
▨ Return to Atlan
Event Duration: After maintenance, a new Return to Atlan event will begin. Once triggered by an adventurer, the event will last for 21 days.

Event Rules: Adventurers who haven't logged in for 7 consecutive days, have a character at level 19 or higher, and whose last return event activation was more than 45 days ago will trigger a series of events upon returning to Atlan. Adventurers who return after October 26 and meet the conditions will keep their eligibility and trigger this Return to Atlan event after the October 28 maintenance.

Event Rewards: This event includes "Returner's Privileges," "Returning Gift," "Returner's Guidebook," "Returning Quest," and more. Join the event to directly claim a full set of Lv.70 Epic Gear and other rewards. You'll also receive Co-op Dungeon buffs, Enhancement Fund drops, and other bonuses during the event to easily boost your character and catch up with the latest content.
Adventurers who haven't logged in since September 10 will participate in the "Pack Check-in" and "Returner's Cumulative Top-up" events during this Return Event, and can claim great rewards.
▨ Journey with Friends
Event Duration: October 28, 06:00 - December 9, 06:00 (Server time of your character's server, available after the maintenance).

The Power Climb Championship Elimination Stage is about to begin! 64 squads from each region are ready to embark on two weeks of elimination battles! Who will emerge victorious from the intense rounds of BO5 battles? Let us bear witness!

1. Matchup Allocation: Based on squad rankings, elimination stage matchups will follow the high-seed vs. low-seed principle. For example: The #1 ranked squad will face the #64 ranked squad in the Top 64 round, and so on.

a. Each round of the Elimination Stage will be BO5 (Best of 5) games, with each match lasting 5 minutes. The first squad to win 3 matches advances to the next round, while the losing squad remains at their current ranking. (Detailed match rules can be viewed in the event rules section)

b. Preparations will be open 5 minutes early in each round of the Elimination Stage. For example, a match starting at 19:00 will become open for preparation at 18:55. Each squad member must confirm their loadouts and press "ready" before joining the match.
c. A new match begins every 6 minutes. For example: BO5 Match 1 at 19:00, BO5 Match 2 at 19:06, BO5 Match 3 at 19:12, and so on.
